pr_title: Fix regular expression for file:/// URLs
pr_body:
It seems as though file:/// URLs aren't currently matched correctly on their origins.

The `file:///` URL has an extra slash when finding a local file, which isn't accounted for in this regular expression. This PR adds an extra optional `/` to the end of the regular expression's matcher for origin.

Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/6141

issue_context.title: Worker bundle URL failing to get file:/// origin
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

I'm trying to import a web worker inside an Electron app. This works fine in parcel most of the time, but then fails when I bundle the app. The code worked in Parcel v1, but I'm having all kinds of problems in Parcel v2.

I've tried all these things:

```
worker = new Worker("./ledWorker.js");
```
```
import ledWorker from './ledWorker';
worker = new Worker(ledWorker);
```
```
 const worker = new Worker(new URL('./ledWorker.js', import.meta.url), {
   type: 'module'
 });
```
```
const worker = new Worker(new URL(workerUrl));
```

But all I get is this:
```
Uncaught Error: Origin not found
    at Object.n.getOrigin (index.8ca53705.js:190)
    at e.exports (marketing.433cd28f.js:1)
    at Object.45QHR../get-worker-url (marketing.433cd28f.js:1)
    at _ (marketing.433cd28f.js:1)
    at c (marketing.433cd28f.js:1)
```

The issue is that the worker file is a local file, `file:///Users/elliott/.../worker.js`. `getOrigin` is returning undefined on the `file:///` URL instead of finding `file://`. 

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/v2/packages/runtimes/js/src/get-worker-url.js#L6

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

I should be able to import a web worker with `new Worker('./myWorker')`

## 😯 Current Behavior

It fails to load the web worker and then raises an exception

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42827/114946775-b2b00200-9e00-11eb-97ef-e4af3e2a06be.png)


## 💁 Possible Solution

I think getOrigin here:

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/7717e2547f510c89ea57bbfec62147bfb912ba49/packages/runtimes/js/src/bundle-url.js#L40

needs to be updated to handle file URLs correctly. It's not currently matching file:/// URLs. Is this intended, or am I doing something wrong?

```
> url = "file///Users/elliott/file.js"
'file///Users/elliott/file.js'
> ('' + url).match(/(https?|file|ftp):\/\/[^/]+/);
null
```

I tried writing a better regular expression for this to find a host, but I am not great at regular expressions.

review_comments:
Do we still need to support IE11 or can we polyfill `URL` dynamically if the user requests IE11 support? Seems it would simplify this code a lot. (potential polyfill https://yarnpkg.com/package/url-polyfill)

This is kinda unrelated to this PR getting merged, is mainly something for core team to consider

cc @mischnic

Every time we included `let` or some newer API like `"...".includes` in a runtime/the prelude, someone opened an issue that it doesn't work on IE11, so I guess we should still support it.

And in this case, `getOrigin()` is 170 bytes, while that polyfill is 6.2kb (both minified but not gzip).

Right, so there's still more need for IE11 than I thought. Thanks for clearing that up.

The polyfill was just a suggestion and should've probably been inserted only if there's IE11 in browserslist, so the bundle would probably be smaller on newer browsers as we don't do any kind of polyfill and always used built-in URL
